name: camayoc_gp_trajectory_replay
description: golden-paths Q1: the ordered replay of one trajectory - each step with its order, label, action, actor, the Decision it enacts and the Verification it produced, where recorded. Absent cells are absent, never invented.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?step ?order ?label ?actionKind ?actor ?decision ?verification WHERE { ?step a aegis:Step ; aegis:stepOf <{trajectory}> ; aegis:stepOrder ?order ; rdfs:label ?label . OPTIONAL { ?step aegis:actionKind ?actionKind } OPTIONAL { ?step aegis:actor ?actor } OPTIONAL { ?step aegis:enacts ?decision } OPTIONAL { ?step aegis:verifiedBy ?verification } } ORDER BY ?order

params.name: trajectory
params.description: trajectory parameter for this stored query.
